validation.comparison_scope: Two stored map fixtures, three widget sizes, two margin configurations, current vs historical filtered preview, Qt offscreen. Warm timing is the median of eight alternating rounds, each 400 hit tests.
validation.live_window: Previous project instance closed through normal WM_CLOSE. New project pythonw -m rouge.app toolbar on screen, not minimized or cloaked, native response verified.

review.standards: Cache the preview positions and both displayed sizes together. Rebuild on each set_map and on changes to widget size/content rectangle. Use the same layout for drawing and mouse hit tests. Pick the current graph before deep-copying the display snapshot, preserve selected floor through a table of tab indexes, and only rebuild the node finder on map refresh. Search and evidence-filter signals use the existing finder, independent explicit refresh reconstructs it. No new exception handlers or speculative defensive rules.
review.requirements: Old and new rasters compared byte-for-byte, and hit identities checked across graph, size, margin, historical/current scope and candidate overlay combinations. Readable selections and refresh after history change covered through the real MapPanel. Preserve all existing endpoint checks pending D81 decision. No game interaction.
